_doc: start_noise: where each ray of the atmosphere pass starts its march (tools/assets/make_blue_noise.py); the pass averages no frames, so a start with a pattern of its own stays on the screen. rain_mist, rain_mist_height_m: the mist the rain alone lays, per unit of rain, and how high it stands; a modelling choice, the 4.0's rule, held to the ground of the rain pair. The drawn sky (render/sky_view.gd, render/weather_view.gd, render/thunder.gd, shaders atmosphere, rain, lightning). rain_fall_ms 8.8: terminal velocity of a large raindrop (Gunn & Kinzer 1949, J. Meteor. 6(4); the paper's table was not read, about 10 m/s for the largest drops by a secondary summary). sound_ms 343: sound in air at 20 C. stroke_s 0.06: the interval between strokes (geometric mean 57 ms over 199 intervals; Rakov & Uman 2003: 3-5 strokes a flash, tens of ms apart). strike_life_s 0.45: longer than the 175 ms mean flash measured in Austria, a modelling choice so the player sees it. bolt_kick, midpoint displacement of the channel: modelling choice compared with reference-minha. puffs: across, up, along, radius of the seven puffs in units of the cloud's size, modelling choice. shadow_strength: the sun's direct share of the light on lit ground (Godot's sun energy over sun plus ambient, measured on daylight.json at noon). mist_beta, fog_extinction, noise_*, rain_box_*, rain_opacity*, thunder_*, sun_gain, overcast_*: modelling choices compared with the 4.0 as the player sees it.
